title: Node
description: A node in the decision tree. `p` is the conditional probability among siblings (siblings sum ~1; the app renormalizes). Payoffs appear on terminal nodes only. Cumulative probability, EV, distributions, conditioning, and optimal-policy annotation are computed client-side and are never part of this schema.

p.description: Conditional probability among siblings. The root's p is 1.

actor.description: Who moves AT this node — whose options the children are (standard game-tree convention). `user` nodes take the max-EV child under backward induction; `counterpart` nodes weight by p or optimize their stated payoffs; `chance` nodes weight by p. Vestigial on terminals.

move.description: The recommended action / what this branch means, one sentence.

payoff.description: Terminal nodes only. Scalar in the scenario's unit, or named components (weighted scalar derived client-side).
